says: A later letter to the same name can overtake an earlier plain send still owed after a storage failure: an owed plain send is retried by the alarm, while a fresh Cmd runs at once, and `behind` holds a Cmd back only behind an owed send_chunks. It predates this branch. The plan's line 190 and the OTP follows row read as order per sender and receiver pair. Not fixed here: widening the wait to plain sends turns the existing M2 alarm law red, so it needs its own design call.
proof: Runner.ts `behind` matches only `cmdType(cmd) === SEND_CHUNKS` among the owed Cmds; the review's plant that waited behind any owed send turned M2 red.
cost: After a storage failure, a reader can see one writer's letters out of the order the writer sent them.
